content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Kansas City

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria, then contact Granite PM Academy to confirm your qualifications before enrolling in the Boot Camp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Attend all sessions to fulfill PMI's mandatory 35 contact-hour education requirement. Our Kansas City cohorts combine expert instruction with real-world project scenarios relevant to the region's infrastructure and manufacturing sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Application & Fee
steps_items.text: After completing the Boot Camp, submit your PMI application and examination fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the submission process and answer questions about documentation and next steps.

steps_items.heading: Prepare & Sit for Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study guides to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your PMP exam through PMI's testing partner, then sit for the computer-based exam with confidence backed by our instructor support.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning the PMP, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs). Granite PM Academy offers ongoing courses and resources to help you meet renewal requirements and stay current in project-management practice.
